content: Ananeneae wanya mansae abusyin wo anya bauname anyuto dei

Umba Yesus po raura pare, “Masyoto Amisye de be akarive Apa kawasae mai no mine vone so omamo raurata irati ananeneae so rai: Namane inta wanya mansae mano abusyin wo yawainye raugav wuruta wo anya bauname anyuto dei.
Wanya radanija makarikuga mbar, yara wanya radanija makarikuga mbare ramu.
Wanya makarikuga mbare ramu wo awa yawainye raugav, weramu awa manine meweno mai.
Yara wanya makarikuga mbare wo awa yawainye raugav muno wo manine rauga tavon ti mamaisy.
Anya bauname umawe de avave jewen ti wo anyuta marudi, weti mamije maomon ti unaki.
Namane yasyin umba udani vatane inta gwain pare, ‘Anya bauname de to! Ti wade indamu wapo aovambe!’
Wanya abusyin umaso unakija usea, wo awa yawainye raindi tetebe.
Wanya makarikuga mbare jewene wo raura nanto wanya makarikuga mbare mansai ware, ‘Reama yawainye mpamo ti wapo manine inta raunande reansai.’

Weramu wanya makarikuga mbare umaso wo raura akananto mai ware, ‘Mamaisye ramu, weye manine manakoe ra mo wansamai tenambe ramu. Weti wata no vatano po manine ramavumbe ratuije nui. Umba wapo inta ramavuno arijat.’

Umbawe wanya awa manine mewene umaso wuruta wo manine ramavun. Arono wuruta, anya bauname umawe de kobe, umba wanya awa manine mamai to umaso utavondijo ai usisa ono vauname rai kobe, umba wo unsanda rauguji.
Umba wanya makarikuga mbare jewene umawe ude ugwain ware, ‘Injae, Injae, unsanda rausiso reansai!’
Weramu po raura uje mai pare, ‘Syantukambe wasai!’ ”
Umba Yesus po ananeneae umaso ama ine raura kakavimbe pare, “Maisyare omai ti, syare wasyisyaube muno wapanatatayaube! Weye syakare ama masyote muno ama uma amije mamo wapantukambe rai.”
Ananeneae vatane mandeija wo doije raeranande awa akarije ai

“Arono Amisye de be akarive Apa kawasae mai no mine vone so omamo raurata ananeneae so rai: Akarije inta pare pusyo ti to no munijo maran, weti po apa vatano wanapatambe aije mawainde, umba po apa ananuge raunanto mai indamu wo raeranande.

Po doije ratodijo mai tetebe, mamaisyo awa vambunine rarijati. Weti apa vatano panapatambe inta pamo po doije vasye ribuge radani raunanto ai inda po raeranande. Muno inta pamo po doije vasye ribuge rurum raunanto ai, muno inta pa ribuge intabo ai.
Umba akarije umaso puje kobe. Vatano po doije vasye ribuge radani raijare umawe pavave poroto po apa doije umawe rasariraeya miridije nseo no ribuge abusyin.
Maisyare omai tavon, vatano po doije vasye ribuge rurum raijare umawe po apa doije umawe rasariraeya miridije nseo no ribuge mambisy.
Yara vatano po doije vasye ribuge intabo raijare umawe poroto po ateme rawae po doije umawe rangkokaibe rai.
Nugoenta rave umba awa akarije umawe pakare. Po apa vatano wanapatambe aije manunugambe akato, pare, ‘Unumeso syare wapo sya doije ranunugambe akare inda syo rator akato.’

Umba vatano po doije vasye ribuge radani raijare umawe de, po doije vasye ribuge abusyin raunande apa akarije ai. Umba po raura pare, ‘Injae, doije vasye ribuge radanijo nyo raunande rinaije omamo syo rasarirae akatoa ribuge radani tavon ti ama manuije mi ribuge abusyin.’

Umba akarije umawe po raura nanto ai pare, ‘Ko dave! Winyamo sya vatano nyanapatambe rinai ngko dave. Winyi no tawan no nya anakere rai mavabe. Ana mamaun inta syo raunande nai nyo raeranande kobe, weti soamo syo ana manakoe inta raunande nai indamu nyo raeranande tavon. Winde, syare wintavondijo sya one rai indamu wansanayanambe tenambe!’

Umba vatano po doije vasye ribuge ruruma raijare umawe de po raura nanto akarije umawe ai pare, ‘Injae, doije vasye ribuge rurumo nyo raunande rinaije ma syo rasarirae akatoa ribuge rurum ti ama manuije ribuge mambisy.’

Umba akarije umawe po raura nanto ai pare, ‘Ko dave! Winyamo sya vatano nyanapatambe rinai ngko dave. Winyi no tawan no nya anakere rai mavabe. Ana mamaun inta syo raunande nai nyo raeranande kobe, weti soamo syo ana manakoe inta raunande nai indamu nyo raeranande tavon. Winde, syare wintavondijo sya one rai indamu wansanayanambe tenambe!’

Umba vatano po doije vasye ribuge intabo raijare umawe de po raura nanto akarije umawe ai pare, ‘Injae, syo naen winyamo naemeno vatane maije jewen. Vatano kaijinta wo anakere raijar, weramu winyamo nyo awa doije raija tenambe.
Weti ijaniv, ti syoroto syo doije vasye ribuge intabo nyo raunande umawe rangkokaibe no kopa ate. Ti Injae, nya doije mi so.’

Umba akarije umawe po raura nanto ai pare, ‘Winyamo vatano mamun muno nyononae ntapekan! Nyanapatambe rinai kobe jewen! Nyo inatantona nyare vatano kaijinta wo anakere raijar, weramu risyamo syo awa doije raija tenambe.

Maisyare omai ti, arono syo doije raunande nai, weamo syare nyo raugato ntami no yavaro doije ntuna raije rai, wirati indamu ama manuije miridije nseo. Inda arono syakare, syo doije umaso raugav muno ama seano miridije nseo ratavon.’
Weti akarije umawe po raura apa naite mai pare, ‘Wapo doije umawe raugavo vatane wato aora, yara wapo raunanto vatano apa doije vasye ribuge abusyine umawe amarom tavon.
Weye are pirati po sya ananuge raeranande kobe, opamo syo kove raunande ai ti manui. Yara are pirati po sya ananuge raeranande kobe jewen, opamo syo apa ananuge raugavo aora.
Muno syare vatano panapatambe kobe jewen wato pamo wapo amaugusyo kaumuro marane rai. No ratuije poyov tawan muno siuri tutir.’ ”
Arono munije ama akari Kristus po vatano ukakainoanive muno vatano kove maosor
“Arono Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, syakare no mine vone so, weamo ride Sya kovo ntiti rautan, muno naito Amisye utavondi Rinai tenambe. Arono naije rituna no Sya kursijo titi rai indamu ibe akarive.
Umba Syo vatano mine tename so manugan bintabo no Rinamun. Umba Syo maosor maisyare vatane inta po domba nawe kambine nawe maosore wemaisy.
Syo domba mansaveto no inanem ngkov, yara Syo kambine maveto no inanem ngkakai. Domba maurata irati vatano utavondi Injayo Amisye apa bekere rai, yara kambine maurata irati vatano wonayo Ai.

Umba Risy, Akarijo Titi, syo raura nanto vatano una no inanem ngkove mai syare, ‘Wade, weapirati Sya Injaya po kove raugaje wasai. Wade wasisa irati Sya munijo ibe akarive raije rai, wemirati Syo ratayao ntuna mo wasanyut no arono mine so ama manasyin.
Weye arono rimaror, wapo anaisye raunande Syo raisy. Arono inawa ngkangkamandi, wapo mana raunande Syo ramanam. Arono ino no maran ti ide, wapo inaugave siso no wapa yavar.
Arono Sya ansune meweno Rinai, wapo ansune inta raunande Syo rave. Arono rigwanen, wade wapo inaeranande. Arono rimakova no tanoano makova ama uga rai, wade wapo inapan.’

Umba vatano utavondi Amisye apa bekere raije umawe wo raura nande Rinai ware, ‘Amisyo winy, nanduija pi wimaror ti reamo anaisye raunande Nyo raisy muno nawa ngkangkamandi ti reamo mana raunande Nyo ramanam?
Nanduija pi reamo naen maisyare vatano no no maran ti de, weti reamo nauga siso no reama yavar? Nanduija pi Nya ansune meweno Nai weti reamo inta raunande Nyo rave?
Nanduija pi reamo naen winggwanen ndako, wimakova no tanoano makova ama uga rai rako, weti reamore wamo napan?’
Umba Syo raura akananto mai syare, ‘Tugae, arono wapo ana umaso raunanto Sya arakovo awa tame maje rave mai, omamo maisyare wapo raunande Rinaije wemaisy.’

Umba Risy, Akarijo Titi umaso, syo raura nanto vatano una no inanem ngkakaije mai syare, ‘Wapuje inaora! Amisye apa mangke maje wasai! Wata wasisa no tanamo mbadururo nuge nuganuije rai, namirati ratayao Anakakai Akoe pe apa naite nawe mansai.
Weye arono rimaror, wapo anaisye inta raunande ti Syo raisye ramu. Arono inawa ngkangkamandi, wapo mana inta raunande Syo ramaname ramu.

Arono ino no maran ti ide, wapo inauga siso no wapa yavare ramu. Arono Sya ansune meweno Rinai, wapo ansune inta raunande Syo rave ramu. Arono rigwanen dako, rimakova no tanoano makova ama uga rai rako, weamo wapo inaeranande ramu.’

Umba wo raura nanto Rinai ware, ‘Amisyo winy, nanduija pirati reamo naeno maror muno nawa ngkangkamandi muno wino no maran ti nde muno Nya ansune meweno Nai muno winggwanen muno wimakova no tanoano makova rai, ti reamanapatambe Naije jewen?’
Umba Syo raura akananto mai syare, ‘Syo raura tugaive: arono waponayo wapo ana umaso raunanto Sya arakovo awa tame maje rave mai, omamo maisyare waponayo wapo raunande Rinaije wemaisy.’
Maisyare omai ti, indati vatano ukakainoanive umaso onawamo mangke nuge nuganuije raunanto mai, yara vatano utavondi Amisye apa bekere rai awave irati kovo nuge nuganuije rai.”
